text_block_list.text: It's a new year, and the beginning of Narita Brian's classic year.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yes?
Yes?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Do you have a kotatsu?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …I need one if I'm going to watch New Year's TV shows. Oh, and oranges, too.
choice_data_list: Is all that really necessary?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yes, it really is.
I set up my office with a kotatsu—a blanket-skirted table with a heater underneath—and oranges, just as Narita Brian requested.
…She's currently warming her legs under said kotatsu.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Turn on the TV. It's about to start.

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year! Thanks for tuning in to the first "Race Bulletin" of the New Year!

text_block_list.name: TV Show Commentator
text_block_list.text: Numerous racers had remarkable performances last year, including Rice Shower, who brought Mejiro McQueen's spring winning streak to a halt!

text_block_list.name: TV Show Commentator
text_block_list.text: And those special three gave us a thrilling competition for the Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text: Yes! And one among them became the face to represent the whole year…

text_block_list.name: TV Show Announcer
text_block_list.text: That's right! Please welcome the Umamusume of the Year… Biwa Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text: Whoa! It's really her!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haha… Hello.

text_block_list.name: TV Show Announcer
text_block_list.text: So, Biwa Hayahide, I hear that Narita Brian, who made her debut this past year, is your little sister. Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That's right. My sister is an incredibly strong racer. Thanks to her, it's been a year of heightened focus for me as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I was only able to take the Kikuka Sho in the Classic Triple Crown tour, but…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I think she has the potential to be Triple Crown Champion.
Murmer…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: (Brian, the Triple Crown Champion?)
(Brian, the Triple Crown Champion?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hm.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: We're out of oranges. I'll go get some.

choice_data_list: (She's… completely unfazed!)

text_block_list.text: Rattle, rattle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Amazon?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I just heard the news. Sounds like you're going on the Triple Crown tour, eh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What of it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'll be on the Tiara tour—the Oka Sho, Japanese Oaks, and Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: …You know, I realized something when I saw you in the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: …That honestly, in my current state, I don't think I could win against you just yet.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: So… I'll do it next year!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna take one year to polish myself up! I'll take the Triple Tiara and get stronger!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Then, I want you to face me one-on-one at the Arima Kinen at the end of the year! You better not run away!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You aim for the three crowns and I'll take the three tiaras. Then we'll see who shines brighter!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, that's all. Later.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Amazon, wait.
Whoosh… Whap!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What's this? An orange?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: A parting gift. Take it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Heh.
choice_data_list: It should be an exciting race.
It should be an exciting race.
Was that because oranges are packed with nutrition?
Was that because oranges are packed with nutrition?
Giving her a fighting chance?
Giving her a fighting chance?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Heh.
choice_data_list: It should be an exciting race.
It should be an exciting race.
Was that because oranges are packed with nutrition?
Was that because oranges are packed with nutrition?
Giving her a fighting chance?
Giving her a fighting chance?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. I saw it in her eyes. She's really planning on getting stronger and bringing the heat.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I have high hopes for when we face off for real.
choice_data_list: Suppose we should do some training then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Can we leave the kotatsu out?
I decide to leave the kotatsu out over New Year's as a reward for training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's exactly right. You need nutrients in order to compete.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: And the two of us are… competing, after all.
choice_data_list: That's a good attitude to have.
That's a good attitude to have.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …I'm just repeating what my big sis said once. They're not my own words.
Narita Brian wastes no time getting back under the kotatsu and eating oranges.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh. I wouldn't call that enough to make a difference.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tell me, what kind of strategy do you have in mind for me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What kind of training will ensure I can face off against Ama after she takes the three tiaras?
And so, I get an early start to this year's race strategizing with a battle-hungry Narita Brian.
